{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid sonic sensors Type 1''' were devices that aided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the detection of intruders hidden or visually camouflaged by means other than [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]]. This version was the most basic, therefore the background noise filtering and other capabilities were minimal.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
